speaker: Doctor
text: That was a very specific occurrence. Did you experience any chest pain, palpitations, or shortness of breath during the episode or the hour leading up to it? Also, have you had any similar episodes in the past, and do you have any history of heart disease or diabetes?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Episode of loss of consciousness. I also have Regained consciousness quickly without confusion, No urinary incontinence, No bite marks or injuries.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Micturition Syncope.

The history of syncope occurring immediately after urination, with rapid recovery and no associated chest pain or injury, is highly specific for reflex syncope triggered by bladder emptying. Given the clear clinical picture, no further diagnostic tests are required.
